qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in concerned/allied/relevant discipline, Master's Degree with at least 55% marks, Minimum research publications and score as per UGC Regulations 2018
qualification.details: Professor: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with, a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2, UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/ Associate Professor / Professor, and / or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate. OR An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/ applied disciplines, from any academic institutions (not included in A above) / industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/ relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years' experience. Associate Professor: A good academic record with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/ relevant Disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever Grading System is followed without grace marks). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy-five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2, UGC Regulations-2018.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SGGU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SGGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the SGGU Professor and Associate Professor recruitment is 11 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Professor and 1 post for Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for the SGGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 750/-.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Associate Professor post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks and a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines are required, along with teaching and research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for the Professor post?
faq.answer: An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, published work of high quality, and a minimum of ten years of teaching or research experience is required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official SGGU website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SGGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Eligibility List Publication, Document Verification, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for SGGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.answer: The official website of Shri Govind Guru University Godhra is https://www.sggu.ac.in/.
